data.title: How 'deeply intertwined' are energy companies in this stage of the AI build-out?
data.description: Laffer Tengler Investments CEO and CIO Nancy Tengler and her panel of experts weigh in on how "deeply intertwined" many energy companies and providers have become in the AI infrastructure build-out.Today's panel includes SHAKTI partner Liz Harrow, Futurum CEO Daniel Newman, and Kelly Intelligence Founder, CEO, and CCO Kevin Kelly.
